# 3ngram v1.8.6

Patch: the engine's runtime dependencies move to their newest releases past
the 7-day cooldown, the deprecated MCP `server-legacy` package is gone, and
zod moves to 4.6.5 with the datetime grammar unchanged.

## Changes

- **MCP SDK 2.3** (#302). `@modelcontextprotocol/server` 2.0.0 -> 2.3.1 and
  `@modelcontextprotocol/node` 2.0.0 -> 2.1.1 move together, leaving one
  `@modelcontextprotocol/core` in the graph. The tool, prompt and
  resource-template surface clients list is byte-for-byte unchanged. Three
  wire behaviours change; see Compatibility.

- **`server-legacy` removed** (#299, resolves #281). `POST
  /oauth/token` now builds its RFC 6749 errors from `OAuthError` in
  `@modelcontextprotocol/server`. Every token-endpoint error keeps its HTTP
  status, JSON body and headers, pinned byte for byte by a new unit suite.
  `express-rate-limit` and `ip-address` leave the graph, and the scoped
  `ip-address` advisory override is dropped.

- **zod 4.6.5** (#300). zod 4.5 began requiring seconds on any time with `Z`
  or an offset; every datetime field now goes through the new
  `isoDateTime()` helper in `@3ngram/schema`, so minute precision such as
  `2026-01-01T06:15Z` still parses and the emitted `date-time` pattern is
  byte-identical. `@3ngram/schema` gains `isoDateTime` and
  `IsoDateTimeOptions`.

- **Runtime minors** (#296). `nodemailer` 10.0.16, `rate-limiter-flexible`
  11.2.1, `pino` 10.4.0, `@node-rs/argon2` 2.2.2, `ipaddr.js` 2.5.0 and
  `jose` 6.2.12. argon2 swapped its Rust backend; hashes keep the same PHC
  format and parameters, and a unit test verifies a hash minted by 2.0.2.
  argon2 2.2.2 drops the `wasm32-wasi` fallback, so a platform without a
  prebuilt native binding no longer falls back to WASM (every linux
  gnu/musl x64/arm64, darwin and win32 target still has one).

- **Worker queue stack** (#298). `bullmq` 5.81.5 and `ioredis` 5.11.1, one
  ioredis copy across server and worker. Since 5.81.2 BullMQ drops
  connection errors no listener receives, so the worker's Queue and Worker
  now register one each and log only the error name and queue name, never
  the message, which can quote stored job data.

- **`@sentry/node` 10.76.0** (#295). Data collection, request-body capture
  and the `beforeSend` / `beforeSendTransaction` scrub are unchanged for
  this config.

- **Security triage 2026-10-12** (#280). `@modelcontextprotocol/client`,
  `vitest`, `js-yaml` and `source-map-js` advisories cleared. Replacing
  the `ioredis-mock` test dependency with a local fake (#293) also removes
  `sprintf-js` (GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c, no patched release) from the graph.

## Compatibility

- **zod lockstep.** Consumers that compose `@3ngram/schema` schemas or types
  with their own `zod` must move to zod 4.6.5 at the same time: zod's
  declarations carry the minor version as a literal type, so mixing copies
  fails to typecheck. Upstream also counts string length bounds in Unicode
  code points, and emitted JSON Schema (MCP `tools/list`, OpenAPI) writes a
  nullable primitive as `type: [T, "null"]` instead of a two-branch
  `anyOf`.
- **MCP wire.** `prompts/get` for `debrief` with `arguments` omitted now
  renders the prompt instead of failing with -32602. A 2026-07-28 POST
  without the `MCP-Protocol-Version` header is refused with 400 / -32020
  (SDK clients always send it). A legacy JSON-RPC batch of more than 100
  messages is refused with 400 / -32600.

## Operations

No migration and no configuration change.
